items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: And I'd sit down and I'd boom-ching, boom-ching for him while he played his clarinet. Cary Levine.

ctx.x: And they also had Mr. Fink, a German fellow. He was teaching bass over there. Oh, they had quite a staff over there. And like I said, the dean was, I called his name earlier, I can't think of it right now. He used to catch me coming down from the last class at night. Come on, Cotton, come on in here. And I'd sit down and I'd boom-ching, boom-ching for him while he played his clarinet. Cary Levine.
